results.headline: This QR sticker is very likely a trap to steal your card details.

results.text: Hello, the room is still available. I'm currently working abroad so can't show it, but if you send the £600 deposit today I'll post you the keys.
results.headline: Do not send this deposit; this looks like a fake rental listing.

results.text: Good morning my love. I wish I could call but the signal on the rig is terrible. I need a small favour, my bank card was blocked and customs want £600 to release my equipment. I'll pay you back the moment I'm home.
results.headline: This looks like a romance scam asking you for money.

results.text: hey can u vote for my cs2 team pls, we're in the final of a school tournament and need 20 votes 🙏 https://cs2-teamvote-arena.com
results.headline: This is a known trick to steal your Steam account.

results.text: Netflix: We couldn't process your last payment. Your account is on hold. Update your billing details within 24 hours to avoid cancellation: https://netflix-billing-update.com
results.headline: This is a fake Netflix message trying to steal your card details.

results.text: Your Geek Squad Total Protection membership has been renewed for $399.99. If you wish to cancel and receive a refund, call our billing department within 24 hours: +1 (888) 000-0000
results.headline: This is a fake renewal notice. Do not call the number.

results.text: Hi! I'm Emma from a digital marketing agency. We're hiring part-time remote staff to like and rate products online. 30-60 mins a day, earn £80-£300 daily. Interested? Reply on WhatsApp.
results.headline: This is a fake job offer designed to take your money later.

results.text: HMRC: You are eligible for a tax refund of £326.18 from the 2025-26 tax year. Claim before it expires: https://hmrc-refund-claim.uk/gov
results.headline: This is a fake HMRC text trying to steal your bank details.

results.text: WINDOWS DEFENDER SECURITY ALERT: Trojan spyware detected. Your banking details are at risk. Do not restart your PC. Call Microsoft Support now: +1 (800) 000-0000
results.headline: This is a fake virus warning. Do not call the number.

results.text: Selling 2 standing tickets for Saturday's show, can't go anymore 😢 £90 each, face value. Bank transfer only, first come first served, DM me!
results.headline: This looks like a common fake ticket sale. Do not pay by bank transfer.

results.text: E-ZPass Notice: You have an outstanding toll balance of $6.99. To avoid a $50 late fee and registration hold, pay today: https://ezpass-tollservices.com/pay
results.headline: This is a fake toll text trying to steal your card details.

results.text: NOTICE OF TRAFFIC VIOLATION - Case #TV-2026-88412. Hearing scheduled 10/14. To avoid court, scan the QR code in the attached notice to settle your $85.00 balance today.
results.headline: This is a fake traffic fine. Do not scan the code or pay.

results.text: Royal Mail: Your parcel is on hold due to an unpaid shipping fee of £1.45. Pay before 23:59 to avoid return: https://royalmail-redelivery.info/pay
results.headline: This is a fake Royal Mail text trying to steal your card details.

results.text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Update within 12 hours: https://usps-redelivery-center.com/track (Reply Y then reopen this message to activate the link)
results.headline: This is a fake USPS text trying to steal your card details.

results.text: Missed call (1 ring) from +375 XX XXX XXXX at 02:14. No voicemail.
results.headline: This looks like a one-ring call trap. Do not ring back.

results.text: Hiya, sorry I accidentally sent my 6 digit code to your number instead of mine, can you send it to me please? It's urgent
results.headline: Do not send that code: it would let someone take over your account.
